ploticus_binary.description: Path to the ploticus executable binary.

mode.description: Mode of operation: 'prefab' to use a built-in template or 'script' to use a user-defined script file.

data_file.description: Path to the input data file. Used by prefabs (as datafile=...) or ignored if mode is script.

output_file.description: Path to the output file where the plot will be saved.

prefab_name.description: Name of the prefab template to use (e.g., vbars, hbars, line, scat). Only used in prefab mode.

prefab_params.description: List of additional parameters for the prefab in 'key=value' format (e.g., x=1, y=2, datafile=/path/to/data). Only used in prefab mode. Note: datafile is often handled separately but can be included here.

script_file.description: Path to the ploticus script file. Only used in script mode.

output_format.description: Desired output format. Supported values include png, svg, gif, jpeg, eps, ps, swf, wbmp. Must match the capabilities of the installed ploticus build.

pixsize.description: Pixel dimensions for the output image in 'width,height' format. Corresponds to -pixsize.

pagesize.description: Paper size in inches in 'width,height' format. Corresponds to -pagesize.

scale.description: Scale factor for the output. Can be a single value or 'sx,sy'. Corresponds to -scale.

title.description: Title or label for the plot. Corresponds to -outlabel.

back_color.description: Background color of the plot. Corresponds to -backcolor.

text_color.description: Default color for text, lines, and data points. Corresponds to -color.

font.description: Font family to use for text. Corresponds to -font.

text_size.description: Default text size in points. Corresponds to -textsize.

tight_crop.description: If true, crops the output image tightly to the plot extent. Corresponds to -tightcrop.

use_cm.description: If true, uses centimeters as absolute units. Corresponds to -cm.

landscape.description: If true, sets landscape orientation (primarily for PostScript). Corresponds to -landscape.

debug.description: If true, enables debug mode, writing diagnostic info to stderr. Corresponds to -debug.
